items.a: AETERNYX® is intended for adult men and women. If you are pregnant, lactating, under 18, over 65, on prescription medication, or managing a diagnosed medical condition, consult a qualified physician before use.

items.q: Can I take AETERNYX® with my other medicines?
items.a: Consult a qualified physician before starting if you are on prescription medication, especially anticoagulants (blood thinners) such as warfarin or acenocoumarol — AETERNYX® contains Vitamin K2-7 (menaquinone-7), which may interact with these medicines.

items.q: Is it safe to take long-term?
items.a: Consult a qualified physician before starting any dietary supplement for extended use. Annual medical review is advisable.

items.q: Why one tablet rather than a stack of pills?
items.a: A single daily tablet is easier to take consistently than ten separate bottles.
Yes. Every active is plant-derived or synthetic. The Vitamin D3 uses a vegetarian source (lichen-derived cholecalciferol). No gelatin, no animal-derived excipients.
If you experience any adverse reaction, discontinue use and consult a qualified physician.
AETERNYX® is manufactured by SunBeam Lifesciences Pvt. Ltd. in Puducherry, India — an ISO 22000, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and HACCP certified facility. FSSAI Manufacturer Licence 10020045000187.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: How Arata Nutraceuticals collects, uses, shares, and protects your personal data, and the rights you have under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

sections.heading: Introduction and Data Fiduciary
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy describes how Arata Nutraceuticals ("Arata Nutraceuticals", "we", "our", "us") collects, uses, shares, protects and otherwise processes your personal data through our website ARATANUTRA.COM ("Platform").

For the purposes of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 ("DPDP Act"), Arata Nutraceuticals is the Data Fiduciary that determines the purpose and means of processing your personal data. Our registered office is Flat No. 107, Vasantha Green View, Sy No. 79 of Hafeezpet, Miyapur, Hyderabad 500049, Telangana, India.

You may browse certain sections of the Platform without registering with us. We do not offer any product or service under this Platform outside India, and your personal data will primarily be stored and processed in India.

By visiting this Platform, providing your information, or availing any product or service offered on the Platform, you expressly consent to the processing of your personal data in accordance with this Privacy Policy, the Terms of Use, and the applicable service/product terms. If you do not agree, please do not use or access our Platform.

sections.heading: Personal data we collect
paragraphs: We collect the following categories of personal data:
Contact and identity data — name, email address, telephone / mobile number, and any information you provide as proof of identity or address.
Order data — shipping address, city, state, PIN code, order history, communication preferences.

Payment data — collected and processed directly by our payment gateway (Razorpay). We do not store your full card number, CVV, UPI PIN or net-banking password on our servers. We only receive a transaction reference and the last four digits of the payment instrument for reconciliation.
Technical data — IP address, device type, browser type, operating system, referring URL, pages viewed and timestamps, collected via cookies and analytics tools (see 'Cookies and analytics' below).
Communications — the content of any emails, WhatsApp messages, or support tickets you send us.

If you receive an email or a call from a person or association claiming to be Arata Nutraceuticals and asking for a card PIN, net-banking password or one-time password, do not share it. Report the incident to us at aratanutra@gmail.com and to your bank.

sections.heading: Purposes and legal basis for processing
sections.intro: We process your personal data for the following purposes, on the legal basis noted for each:

items: Fulfilling your order (name, address, phone, payment) — legitimate contractual purpose under the DPDP Act.
Sending order confirmation, dispatch and delivery updates by email and WhatsApp — necessary for performance of the order.
Providing customer support and handling grievances — necessary for performance and required under Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020.
Detecting, preventing and investigating fraud, unauthorised transactions and abuse of the Platform — legitimate interests.
Complying with tax, accounting and other statutory obligations — legal obligation.
Analysing website usage in aggregated, anonymised form (via Google Analytics 4 and Meta Pixel) — only after you provide consent through the cookie banner.
Marketing communications about our products, offers and updates — only after you provide consent, and you may withdraw consent at any time.

sections.heading: Third-party processors and disclosures
sections.intro: We share personal data only with the following categories of trusted third parties, each of which processes data on our behalf under a contract requiring appropriate security and confidentiality:

items: Netlify Inc. (hosting and application runtime) — processes technical data and any data submitted through the Platform.
Razorpay Software Pvt. Ltd. (payment processing) — processes name, email, phone and payment instrument details.
Resend Inc. (transactional email delivery) — processes name and email address to send order confirmations and shipping notifications.
Courier and logistics partners (e.g. Bluedart, DTDC, India Post, as applicable per shipment) — processes name, phone and shipping address to deliver your order.
Google LLC (Google Analytics 4) — processes technical and usage data, only after you consent via the cookie banner.
Meta Platforms Inc. (Meta Pixel) — processes technical and usage data, only after you consent via the cookie banner.

paragraphs: We may also disclose personal data to government agencies, courts or law enforcement authorities if required to do so by law or in good-faith belief that such disclosure is reasonably necessary to respond to legal process, enforce our Terms, or protect the rights, property, or safety of our users or the public.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to remember your preferences (e.g. cookie consent choice) and, only after you consent, to measure how visitors use the Platform.
Strictly-necessary cookies (session, security, consent state) are set without asking, because the Platform cannot function without them. They store no marketing identifier.

Analytics and advertising cookies (Google Analytics 4 and Meta Pixel) are set only after you accept the cookie banner shown on your first visit. Declining leaves these tags dormant. You can change your choice later by clearing site data for aratanutra.com in your browser and reloading the site.

Third-party analytics providers may set their own cookies and transmit data to servers outside India (see the 'Cross-border data transfer' section below). Please review their privacy policies for details.

sections.heading: Cross-border data transfer
paragraphs: Personal data is stored primarily in India. When you accept analytics or advertising cookies, technical data (IP address, device identifiers, page views) is transmitted to Google (Google Analytics 4) and Meta (Meta Pixel), which may process that data on servers in the United States and other jurisdictions.

The Government of India may from time to time notify countries to which personal data may not be transferred under Section 16 of the DPDP Act. We will comply with any such restriction and will update this Privacy Policy accordingly.

sections.heading: Children's data
paragraphs: The Platform and our products are intended for adults aged 18 years or older. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children (individuals under 18 years) or persons with a legal guardian, as defined under the DPDP Act.

If a parent or lawful guardian believes that a child has submitted personal data to us without their verifiable consent, please contact the Grievance Officer immediately at aratanutra@gmail.com and we will delete such data promptly.

sections.heading: Security precautions
paragraphs: We adopt reasonable security practices and procedures to protect personal data from unauthorised access, disclosure, loss or misuse. These include HTTPS/TLS for all data in transit, encryption of secrets at rest, bcrypt-hashed administrator credentials, rate limiting on sensitive endpoints, and access controls that restrict who inside Arata Nutraceuticals can view your data.

However, the transmission of information over the internet is not completely secure for reasons beyond our control. By using the Platform, you accept the residual security implications of data transmission over the internet and are responsible for ensuring the protection of any login credentials you use to access the Platform.

sections.heading: Data breach notification
paragraphs: In accordance with Section 8(6) of the DPDP Act, if we become aware of a personal data breach that is likely to affect your rights, we will notify the Data Protection Board of India and the affected Data Principals without undue delay, describing the nature of the breach, the categories of data affected, the likely consequences, and the measures taken or proposed to address the breach.

sections.heading: Data retention
paragraphs: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, or as required by applicable law. Specifically:
Order and invoice data — retained for 8 (eight) financial years to comply with the Income Tax Act, 1961 and the Goods and Services Tax law.
Customer support communications — retained for 3 (three) years from the last interaction.
Marketing consent records — retained until you withdraw consent, and thereafter as required to prove the earlier consent.
Technical and analytics data — retained in aggregated, anonymised form indefinitely; identifiable technical logs are retained for 90 (ninety) days.
After the applicable retention period, personal data is deleted or irreversibly anonymised.

sections.heading: Your rights under the DPDP Act, 2023
sections.intro: As a Data Principal you have the following rights, exercisable free of charge by writing to the Grievance Officer (contact details below):

items: Right to access — obtain a summary of the personal data we process about you and the purposes.
Right to correction and erasure — have inaccurate data corrected, incomplete data completed, or personal data erased when no longer required (subject to our retention obligations).
Right to nominate — nominate another individual to exercise your rights in the event of your death or incapacity.
Right to grievance redressal — raise a complaint about the way we handle your personal data. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may escalate to the Data Protection Board of India.

Right to withdraw consent — withdraw any consent you previously gave for the processing of your personal data. Withdrawal is not retrospective; processing carried out before withdrawal remains lawful. Withdrawing consent that is necessary for the provision of a service may result in us being unable to continue that service.

paragraphs: To exercise any of these rights, write to the Grievance Officer at aratanutra@gmail.com with the subject line 'DPDP request'. We may need to verify your identity before acting on the request.

sections.heading: Consent
paragraphs: By visiting our Platform or by providing your information, you consent to the collection, use, storage, disclosure and other processing of your personal data on the Platform in accordance with this Privacy Policy. If you provide us any personal data relating to other people, you represent that you have the authority to do so.

By providing your contact details, you consent to us and our authorised service providers contacting you through SMS, instant messaging apps, calls and/or email for the purposes specified in this Privacy Policy. You may withdraw your consent at any time by writing to the Grievance Officer with the subject line 'Withdrawal of consent for processing personal data'. Withdrawal of consent will not be retrospective.

sections.heading: Changes to this Privacy Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or applicable law. Where changes are material, we will notify you by email or through a prominent notice on the Platform before the changes take effect. The 'Last updated' date at the top of this policy indicates when it was most recently revised.

sections.heading: No returns on opened or used product (hygiene)
paragraphs: AETERNYX® is a sealed nutraceutical. For product-safety and hygiene reasons, we do not accept returns, exchanges or refunds on any strip whose foil seal has been broken, whose outer carton has been opened, or which shows any sign of use. This is consistent with Indian nutraceutical industry practice and with the applicable Food Safety and Standards regulations.
Change-of-mind returns on opened or partially-consumed product are not eligible under any circumstance.

sections.heading: Damaged, defective, tampered or wrong product
sections.intro: If the parcel you receive is damaged, defective, tampered with, or the wrong product, we will make it right. To claim, you must:

items: Report the issue within 48 hours of delivery — email aratanutra@gmail.com or WhatsApp +91 99599 93973 with your order ID.

Provide an unboxing video that clearly shows the outer courier bag unopened, the AETERNYX® carton being taken out, and the issue you are reporting. Photos alone are not sufficient for damage claims; the video is required to protect against transit tampering.
Do not throw away the outer packaging, courier label, invoice or product — we may need them for the courier claim.
Wait for our confirmation before shipping anything back. Once we confirm, we will arrange a reverse pickup at our cost, or share a return address for you to send it to us.

paragraphs: After we receive and inspect the returned item, we will either replace the product free of charge or refund the amount you paid (including original shipping) using the process described below. Reports made after 48 hours of delivery, or without an unboxing video for damage claims, may not be entertained.

sections.heading: Refund method and timeline
paragraphs: Once a cancellation or return is approved, refunds are credited to the original payment source (the card, UPI ID or wallet used at checkout). This is a requirement of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 and Razorpay's settlement rules — we cannot refund to a different account or issue a bank transfer.

Refunds are initiated by us within 2 (two) working days of approval. It typically takes an additional 5–7 working days for the amount to appear in your account, depending on your card issuer or bank. You will receive an email confirmation with the Razorpay refund reference when the refund is initiated.

sections.heading: Shipping charges on refunds
paragraphs: Where the return is due to a fault on our side (damaged, defective, tampered or wrong product), the original shipping charge is fully refunded and reverse pickup is at our cost.
Where the parcel is refused at the doorstep for reasons unrelated to product fault, the shipping charge (if any) is non-refundable and only the product amount is refunded.

returns.title: Return Policy
returns.summary: The strict hygiene-based return conditions for AETERNYX® and how defective or damaged shipments are handled.

sections.heading: Consumable product notice
paragraphs: AETERNYX® is a sealed consumable nutraceutical. For product-safety and hygiene reasons, and consistent with Indian nutraceutical industry practice under the applicable Food Safety and Standards regulations, opened or used product cannot be returned, exchanged or refunded under any circumstance.
This Return Policy should be read together with the Refund & Cancellation Policy at /refund-and-cancellation. In the event of any conflict between the two, the more specific provision governs.

items: Damaged, defective, tampered or wrong product delivered to you, reported within 48 hours of delivery with an unboxing video (see 'How to raise a return' below).
Unopened strips or boxes with intact foil seals and undisturbed outer carton, only where we have confirmed acceptance before you ship the item back.
Any strip whose foil seal has been broken, or whose outer carton has been opened.
Change-of-mind returns on any opened or partially-consumed product.
Reports made more than 48 hours after delivery.
Products purchased during promotional sales explicitly marked as final sale.
Email aratanutra@gmail.com or message WhatsApp +91 99599 93973 within 48 hours of delivery, quoting your order ID.
Attach the required unboxing video for any damage, defect or tampering claim.
Do not ship anything back before we confirm. If we approve the return, we will arrange a reverse pickup at our cost or share a return address for you to use.

sections.heading: Inspection, replacement and refund
paragraphs: Once we receive the returned product, we will inspect it within 3 (three) working days. If approved, you may choose either (a) a free replacement dispatched to your original shipping address, or (b) a refund credited to the original payment source per our Refund & Cancellation Policy.

If, on inspection, the product does not qualify (for example, the seal was broken before we received it, or the claim was raised after 48 hours), we will notify you and, at your option, either ship the item back to you at your cost or dispose of it.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.summary: How and when we ship AETERNYX® across India.

sections.heading: Where we ship
paragraphs: We ship AETERNYX® across India only. Country of origin: India. We do not currently accept international orders, and we are unable to ship to APO, FPO or non-serviceable PIN codes as determined by our courier partners. If your PIN code is not serviceable at checkout, please contact us and we will let you know whether we can dispatch via India Post.

sections.heading: Dispatch timeline
paragraphs: Orders placed and successfully paid for by 4:00 PM IST on a working day are typically dispatched the next working day. Orders placed after 4:00 PM IST, on Sundays, or on national holidays are dispatched on the following working day.

In all cases, we aim to hand your order over to the courier within 5 (five) working days of receiving cleared payment. We will notify you by email and, where a mobile number is provided, WhatsApp when your order is dispatched.

sections.heading: Delivery timeline
paragraphs: Once dispatched, most orders across India are delivered within 3–7 working days, depending on your destination PIN code and the courier's own network schedules. Metro and Tier-1 city PINs typically deliver faster; remote and North-East PINs may take longer.

Arata Nutraceuticals is not liable for delays caused by the courier or by circumstances beyond our reasonable control — including weather, strikes, riots, curfews, natural disasters or acts of governmental authority.

sections.heading: Tracking and order updates
paragraphs: You will receive an order confirmation email the moment your payment is successful, and a separate dispatch email that includes the courier name and tracking number. Tracking updates are also shared on WhatsApp where you have provided a mobile number.

Delivery is made to the address provided at checkout. Please double-check the PIN code, house number, landmark and phone number before completing payment — we cannot re-route a parcel once it has been dispatched.

sections.heading: Undeliverable or refused parcels
paragraphs: If a parcel is undelivered because the recipient was unavailable across the courier's re-attempt window, because the address was incorrect, or because delivery was refused at the doorstep for reasons unrelated to product fault, the parcel will be returned to us as an 'RTO' (Return to Origin).

On receipt of an RTO parcel, we will contact you to either re-ship (you cover the second-attempt shipping charge) or refund the product amount less the original outbound shipping charge. Refunds follow the timeline described in the Refund & Cancellation Policy.

sections.heading: Shipping charges
paragraphs: Shipping charges are shown clearly at checkout, alongside the product price, and are inclusive of all applicable taxes. Charges vary by pack size — the 3-strip pack and the 10-strip (100-tablet) pack currently ship free across India; the 1-strip pack carries a flat shipping charge.

sections.heading: Shelf life at delivery
paragraphs: Every product dispatched will have at least 30% of its shelf life, or at least 45 days before expiry, remaining at the time of delivery.
